description: Create a metric based on APM span data (count or distribution, with filters and group-by)

aggregationType.description: Aggregation type. 'count' counts span events, 'distribution' creates a distribution metric

filterQuery.description: APM search query to filter spans. Example: service:web-app resource_name:GET_/api/users

groupBy.description: Fields to group the metric by

path.description: Path to the value to aggregate over. Example: @resource_name

tagName.description: Tag name for the group. Defaults to path if not specified

id.description: The name of the span-based metric. Example: spans.request_duration

includePercentiles.description: Whether to include percentile aggregations. Only for distribution metrics

path.description: Path to the metric value. Required for distribution metrics. Example: @duration

name: create-spans-metric
